case.value: As the bulls (10 of 13-14 analysts at Strong Buy/Buy, Wedbush's $75 target) frame it, IonQ is the commercial leader of the trapped-ion quantum computing race, with revenue up 286.7% y/y last quarter and management guiding organic growth to stay above 100% for the full year as enterprise and government partnerships scale.

depends_on.value: Whether FY2026 revenue actually lands at the guided $280-290M (vs. $268.2M consensus) while the adjusted EBITDA loss (guided to $310-330M) narrows over time rather than widening further, and whether stock-based compensation (already exceeding revenue on a TTM basis) moderates.

bear_case.value: IonQ trades near 52x forward sales with persistent large GAAP and cash losses (TTM FCF -$484M), SBC alone exceeds TTM revenue, insiders have been sellers only in recent months, and a new Nasdaq-listed competitor (IQM Quantum Computers) plus broad high-valuation de-rating in quantum names have driven the stock down over 53% from its high.

why_it_fell.value: Down 53.3% from its 52-week high on a combination of sector-wide de-rating of high-multiple quantum computing names (trading near 52x forward sales), persistent large operating and adjusted-EBITDA losses despite triple-digit revenue growth, ongoing insider selling, and new competitive entrants (Nasdaq-listed IQM Quantum Computers) diluting investor attention and capital in the space.

judgment.prospect_why: The case is trapped-ion leadership scaling into enterprise quantum; revenue is real and growing 287% year over year with FY26 guided up to $280-290M, but the twelve-month path to the $67.68 target rests on commercial quantum advantage that is years out, so this is story visibility with a small revenue ramp attached.
judgment.competition_why: Gross margin fell from 48.0% to 26.3% over four quarters while revenue grew, which is buying share not earning it, and the architecture race against far better-capitalised superconducting programmes plus a new entrant in IQM means the returns the prospect needs are contestable.
judgment.macro_fit_why: This is the definitional long-duration equity: no earnings, $483.9M of annual cash burn, stock-based compensation at 182.6% of revenue, and commercialisation years away, against a 2.42% real 10-year and a live September hike; the thesis needs the rate regime to change.
judgment.narrative_why: Quantum is a narrative more than an earnings theme, and its proxy is de-rating: momentum was the worst factor over one month, and the stock is down 53.3% from its high with three-month relative strength of -34.8 points against the S&P 500.
